shots.focal_element: Suited presenter in profile at a retro office cubicle, slightly right of centre
shots.transition_other: video start (single opening frame, no incoming transition)
shots.typography: Corner channel bug: small bold uppercase sans 'SEMRUSH' with logo mark above heavy condensed 'TV', black on a white rounded badge, top-right.
shots.what_happens: A one-frame (about 0.04 s) opening still of the presenter in profile at a 90s cubicle with shallow depth of field; it reads as the head frame of the following live-action take rather than a designed shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Open on the first frame of the live-action plate with the persistent 'SEMRUSH TV' corner badge already composited top-right as a fixed overlay layer.

shots.focal_element: Suited presenter addressing camera in a retro open-plan office, with coworkers in the background
shots.transition_other: continuation of the opening take; the camera whips from a tight close-up into a wide (motion-blurred frame around 1.0 s)
shots.typography: Burned-in captions: small italic sans-serif in sentence case, white on a black rectangular plate, centred lower third, with ellipses bridging phrases; persistent bold uppercase 'SEMRUSH TV' badge top-right.
shots.what_happens: The presenter turns to camera in close-up and asks the opening question (w0-w11); the camera whips/pulls back to a wide of a 90s cubicle office as he stands and walks forward, opening his arms on 'switching between platforms?'. Phrase-by-phrase captions track the VO.
shots.build_rebuild: Live-action wide of the presenter with a fast whip pull-back from close-up, overlaid with phrase-chunked lower-third captions (white italic sans on a black plate) timed to word indices w0-w11.

shots.focal_element: A stack of beige CRT monitors whose screens show composited SEO-issue UI cards and talking-head copies of the presenter, with a woman typing on the right
shots.typography: Captions in white italic sans on black plates, sentence case. Monitor UI uses small uppercase labels ('SITEMAP ISSUES') over bolder sentence-case alerts with warning-triangle and red X icons, in a clean product-UI sans; some monitor text is too small to read.
shots.what_happens: A woman types at a desk of old CRT monitors. Each monitor's screen is replaced with either stacked Semrush-style issue cards (sitemap/robots.txt warnings, readability/keyword alerts, a 14% Poor score) or the presenter's face. The screens change on each listed task (SEO, ads, content, analytics; w12-w22), and by the end several screens show the presenter, looking stressed.
shots.build_rebuild: Screen-replace each CRT in a live plate with corner-pinned UI card stacks or talking-head clips, and swap their contents on the VO words SEO/ads/content/analytics (w15, w19, w20, w22).

shots.focal_element: Exasperated man in a purple shirt holding up a long continuous-feed printout
shots.typography: Same lower-third caption style: white italic sans, sentence case, black plate; persistent corner TV badge.
shots.what_happens: A heavy directional motion blur (whip) resolves into a new character grimacing behind a sheet of printer paper in a grey cubicle, with printers on both sides, as the VO starts 'paying for tools' (w23).
shots.build_rebuild: Cut into the new plate with a 3-4 frame horizontal whip: directional blur that ramps from high to zero, timed so the image is sharp by the first word of the new phrase (w23).

shots.focal_element: First the paper-throwing man; then (from about 12.5 s) the presenter's head popping out of a metal filing drawer, next to a 'DRIVING GROWTH' sticker title and an animated green growth line
shots.transition_other: no visible cut at the boundary; the action continues from s004, so this is likely a detector split inside one take
shots.typography: Captions as before. 'DRIVING GROWTH' is a heavy black italic geometric sans in all caps, tightly tracked, set on two lines inside a sticker-style plate with a white outline and a soft iridescent purple-blue glow, upper left.
shots.what_happens: The man flings printouts into the air in frustration (w23-w30). Around 12.5 s there is an undetected cut inside the shot: a hand opens a filing-cabinet drawer and the presenter's head pops up in it. A 'DRIVING GROWTH' sticker title sits at left while a thick lime-green stroke draws on in two segments around his head like a rising growth line (w31-w40).
shots.build_rebuild: Composite a tilted sticker title (heavy italic caps with a white outline and a glow) at the upper left, and draw on a thick rounded lime stroke path with a stroke-dashoffset tween that leaves a gap behind the subject's head.

shots.focal_element: A Semrush-branded vending machine covered in toolkit stickers (left) and the presenter walking in to stand beside it (right)
shots.transition_other: transition not clearly visible on the 2 fps sheet; it coincides with a glitch-like SFX candidate (x005)
shots.typography: Product-label stickers in mixed shapes (hexagon, oval, heart, starburst, pill) with bold rounded sans, mostly in caps, black on bright fills; 'ALL-IN-ONE PLATFORM' is a heavy italic caps headline with a white outline; the machine header has a glossy wordmark with the logo. Captions are white italic sans on black plates.
shots.what_happens: The presenter walks into frame and stops beside a vending machine whose glass front is a branded poster: a soda bottle, the presenter holding an 'ALL-IN-ONE PLATFORM' can, and stickers naming the toolkits (AI, Advertising, Local, Social, SEO, Traffic & Market). He delivers the solution line (w41-w52). On 'all in one place' (about 19.5 s) the camera pushes in or whips toward the machine's selection buttons.
shots.build_rebuild: Build the toolkit menu as a vending-machine front: a grid of shaped, colour-coded stickers, each labelled with one toolkit name, around a central 'ALL-IN-ONE PLATFORM' headline, held while the VO names the benefit, then a fast push-in to the selection keypad.
